svg.title: What stayed? What was lost?
svg.desc: Four scenes show two selected toy repairs. Compatible blunt ends retain all fourteen base pairs. Opposing resected three-prime tails align one GAC/CTG segment with exactly two unmatched TT flaps. After trimming, seven paired bases have a top nick between slots five and six and a bottom nick between slots two and three. Sealing retains seven base pairs. Seven are lost by bookkeeping. A junction does not prove Pol theta dependence.
